name: with-aart
description: Agent-first onboarding for AART — wires a coding agent's per-workspace MCP config (via `aart init-agent`) and installs AART's working instructions globally, one host install covering every AART-enabled project. Colocated inside team-monet/aart rather than published separately: AART itself is still pre-1.0.0 (see ../AUTHORING.md part (b)), so `private: true` here reflects that stage, not a decision against ever publishing this harness on its own.
